method: Serial independent native module graphs; exact multiset matching of full serialized records; then source-rendered branch triangle difference and unanimated baseline tree mesh intersection. No checkout writes, product overrides or scene renderer.

limitations: No removal is applied or authorized by this report. Changed geometry membership must be checked against approved landing ranges; first awning entry/rail and protected native road are excluded from automatic decisions.

Tree tests compare actual static crown/trunk mesh faces. Wind, ink outline, blossom and fruit attachments are not included. A mesh entirely containing another without surface crossing is not reported by the triangle test.
Shrubs, flowers and tufts are conservative envelope candidates requiring exact follow-up before deletion.

Source WORLD_SOLIDS and original branch payloads are retained in both snapshots for support/collision follow-up; surface triangle witnesses include actual drawn posts, cross braces, deck skins and ground supports. Runtime support collider mismatches are not silently treated as equivalent to drawn supports.
Locality distances are lower bounds to actual changed triangle boxes; large distances prove nonlocal drift, small distances alone do not prove an approved local change.
